name: openclaw-plugin-page-stats
description: OpenClaw tool plugin that reads a web page and reports its title and word count
author: Yan Su

scripts.plugin:build: pnpm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:check: pnpm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js --check
scripts.plugin:validate: pnpm run build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js
